results.notes: Nine Dime migration, observability, provenance, pricing, traffic, context, routing, trace, and audit test files.
Client preview guard and bundled server build completed successfully.
Chat critical-path gzip remained 689 bytes under the configured ceiling.
Frozen synthetic route evidence matches its source and control hashes.

First apply, second apply, historical-null preservation, guarded rollback, and second rollback passed in a disposable MySQL 8 container. The pre-existing full migration history still fails before 0122 on duplicate wc2026_matches creation.

Five tests were pending. One sandbox-only perf-harness failure passed when rerun with local IPC/browser permission; the remaining failures require unavailable databases, credentials, or live APIs. This result is not represented as a repository-wide pass.
